title: Endpoint Reporting & Dashboards for Intune and Configuration Manager
author_notes: Effort tier: T2 (reporting/visibility layer over existing Intune + Configuration Manager data; moderate config, pilot-to-prod).
hook: Turn Intune and Configuration Manager data into reports leadership and auditors actually trust
problem: You manage thousands of endpoints, but when someone asks "how many devices are patched?" or "what's our compliance rate?" the honest answer is a scramble through three consoles and a spreadsheet. This solution gives you a repeatable endpoint reporting layer across Intune and Configuration Manager: standard reports for patch status, compliance, encryption, app deployment, and device health, plus dashboards that pull from Intune reporting and Graph — so the same numbers come out the same way every time.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Intune and Configuration Manager reporting data sources, Intune device/compliance reports, Microsoft Graph data export, what good endpoint KPIs look like, and the reusable dashboard model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Configuration Manager reporting, Graph permissions/app registration for exports, a reporting destination, KPI definitions) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the KPI set, enable and locate the built-in Intune/Configuration Manager reports, set up Graph-based data export, assemble dashboards, schedule recurring reports and distribution, then validate the numbers and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — reporting-readiness discovery, report-data validation (reconcile counts), a consolidated endpoint KPI report (patch/compliance/encryption/health), a scheduled export helper, and a reporting-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable endpoint reporting and dashboard layer across Intune and Configuration Manager — patch, compliance, encryption, app, and health reporting that produces the same trusted numbers every time. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A repeatable endpoint reporting and dashboard layer across Intune and Configuration Manager — patch, compliance, encryption, app, and health reporting that's consistent every time.
meta_title: Endpoint Reporting & Dashboards for Intune and Configuration Manager
meta_description: Build endpoint reporting and dashboards across Intune and Configuration Manager: KPI definitions, built-in reports, Microsoft Graph exports, scheduled distribution. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Trustworthy, repeatable endpoint reporting — patch, compliance, encryption, app deployment, and device health across Intune and Configuration Manager — with the same numbers every time for leadership and auditors, proven on a pilot before you scale.
